title: Kitchen Cabinet Planner with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file implementing a 3D kitchen cabinet planner with time-of-day lighting control using Three.js.

## Scene Setup
- Initialize a Three.js scene with a WebGLRenderer (antialias, shadows enabled), sized to the full window.
- Use OrbitControls for camera interaction. Camera starts at position (5, 4, 8) looking at origin.
- Create a kitchen room: floor (10x10, wood-colored #8B7355), back wall (10x4, cream #FFF8DC), and left wall (10x4, cream #FFF8DC).
- Add a grid of kitchen cabinets: 3 base cabinets along the back wall (each 1.2w x 0.9h x 0.6d, brown #654321) placed at x = -2, 0, 2 with y = 0.45. Each cabinet has a door (slightly lighter brown #8B6914) that can open.
- Add 2 wall cabinets above the base cabinets at x = -1 and 1, y = 2.5, size 1.5w x 0.8h x 0.4d, same colors.
- Load the 'soldier.glb' model using GLTFLoader from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js'. Place the soldier at position (3, 0, 3) scaled to 1.5. This represents a human reference figure for scale. If the model has animations, play the first animation.
- Add a countertop: a flat box (8w x 0.05h x 0.7d) at y=0.925 along the back wall, marble-colored #D4C5A9.

## Lighting & Time Control
- Implement a time-of-day system controlled by a slider (id='timeSlider', range 0-24, step 0.5, default 12).
- Display current time as HH:MM on a label (id='timeLabel').
- At time 6 (dawn): warm orange ambient (intensity 0.3), directional light at low angle, color #FFA500.
- At time 12 (noon): bright white ambient (intensity 0.7), directional light from above, color #FFFFFF, intensity 1.0.
- At time 18 (dusk): warm red ambient (intensity 0.3), directional light at low angle opposite side, color #FF6347.
- At time 0/24 (midnight): very dim blue ambient (intensity 0.1), no directional light, add a point light inside the room (simulating kitchen light, #FFFFAA, intensity 0.5).
- Interpolate smoothly between these key times.

## Cabinet Interaction
- Clicking on a base cabinet door toggles it open/closed. Open = rotate door mesh 90 degrees around its left edge. Track open state per cabinet.
- A DOM panel (id='cabinetPanel') shows: 'Cabinets Open: X/3' where X is the count of open base cabinets.
- Pressing keys '1', '2', '3' toggles base cabinets 0, 1, 2 respectively.

## Cabinet Color Customization
- Add 4 color swatch buttons in a div (id='colorPalette'): Oak (#8B6914), Walnut (#654321), White (#F5F5F5), Navy (#1B1B3A). Each button has class 'color-swatch' and a data-color attribute.
- Clicking a swatch sets the selected cabinet color. The 'selected cabinet' is tracked: click a cabinet body (not door) to select it. Selected cabinet gets a highlight outline (emissive glow).
- Display selected cabinet index in a span (id='selectedCabinetLabel').

## Cost Estimator
- Display a cost panel (id='costPanel'). Base cabinets cost $200 each, wall cabinets $150 each. Color surcharge: Oak +$0, Walnut +$25, White +$50, Navy +$75.
- Total cost updates live. Show in format 'Total: $XXXX'.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- timeOfDay: current slider value (number)
- ambientIntensity: current ambient light intensity (number)
- directionalIntensity: current directional light intensity (number)
- cabinetDoors: [bool, bool, bool] for base cabinet open states
- openCount: number of open cabinets
- selectedCabinet: index (0-4, -1 if none; 0-2 base, 3-4 wall)
- cabinetColors: array of 5 hex color strings
- totalCost: number
- soldierLoaded: boolean (true once GLB loads)
- soldierPosition: {x, y, z}
- cameraPosition: {x, y, z}
- frameCount: integer incrementing each frame

## HUD
- All UI panels positioned with CSS fixed/absolute, z-index above canvas.
- A title bar at top: 'Kitchen Cabinet Planner' (id='titleBar').
- Time slider and label at bottom center.
- Cabinet panel at top-right.
- Color palette at left side.
- Cost panel at bottom-right.

Ensure all state values are updated every frame in the animation loop. Use requestAnimationFrame.
physics_constraints: Cabinet doors rotate exactly 90 degrees when opened. Lighting intensity interpolates linearly between keyframe times. Cost calculation must be deterministic based on cabinet colors. All positions must remain NaN-free.
